stable_traits.personality: Determined, increasingly confident in command though still uncertain of his lordly role. Growing sense of responsibility. Conflicted about his feelings for Selene and his destiny.

aliases_observed.notes: Being addressed as a lord by Hurin and others
Perrin thinks this name; it appears to be a wolf name for Rand

characters.notes: Wears ornate coats with silver herons and rapids. Has invitations from both Barthanes and Galldrian. Burned letters from Selene. The text shows him taking command naturally despite claiming not to, and others seeing him differently than before—fitting his lordly coat.

stable_traits.personality: Calm, thoughtful, strategic. Subtly manipulative. Knowledgeable about sa'angreal and the Age of Legends.

characters.notes: Heals Hurin with the One Power. Has stayed at The Great Tree before. Insists on obtaining entry to Barthanes's manor to retrieve the Horn.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Flushed cheeks, prominent cheekbones becoming visible
stable_traits.personality: Still maintains humor despite illness. Desperate to recover the dagger.

characters.notes: Looking increasingly ill—feverish flush, tight cheeks, eating ravenously as if his last meal. Juggling eggs. Concerned about recovering the dagger that is tied to his illness.

stable_traits.personality: Thoughtful, protective of his friends. Troubled by his wolf connection and his use of the axe instead of a smith's hammer. Perceptive of others' changes.

characters.notes: Revealed to be a 'sniffer' like Hurin—he followed the trail to the Foregate. Can sense smells/scents. Thinks of Rand as 'Shadowkiller,' a wolf name. Yellow-eyed. Dreams of raw meat. Internally conflicted about smithing vs. fighting.
Reading books from Fal Dara. Traveled with Rand through the Portal Stone. Claims to have grown used to walking again.

stable_traits.personality: Driven, increasingly desperate to recover the Horn. Plays stones with slashing, daring style. Shows respect for Aes Sedai authority but is impatient.

characters.notes: Says 'I must have it. I must!' about the Horn with intensity that surprises Hurin. Defers to Rand's leadership in some matters now.

stable_traits.personality: Dutiful, somewhat fatalistic ('what happens, happens'). Loyal.

aliases_observed.notes: His ability to track by scent

characters.notes: Was attacked and injured, healed by Verin. Tracked the thieves to Barthanes's manor. Can smell violence and evil. Proud of Rand's status as 'Lord Rand.'

stable_traits.personality: Ambitious, involved in plots. Potentially a Darkfriend.

characters.notes: Just finished building a great manor. Sent Rand an invitation. His manor is where the Horn and dagger were taken. Trolloc scent detected around the place. Possibly plotting against King Galldrian.

stable_traits.personality: Ambitious, glory-seeking, would keep the Horn for Cairhien's prestige. Politically ruthless.

characters.notes: Sent Rand an invitation (which Verin crumpled and discarded). Has a project to dig up and move a sa'angreal statue from the Age of Legends. Would likely seize the Horn if given the chance.

stable_traits.personality: Alluring, mysterious. Can apparently use Portal Stones.

characters.notes: Rand burned her letters. He remembers her beauty and perfume vividly. She helped them travel via Portal Stone. Verin expresses interest in meeting her because of her ability to use Portal Stones—a rare skill.

stable_traits.personality: Unctuous manner, listens carefully to unspoken meanings. Knows Verin and shows warm welcome.

characters.notes: Innkeeper of The Great Tree in Cairhien. Could be Cuale's sister (similar manner and build). Knows Verin is Aes Sedai though never says it aloud.
His inn (The Defender of the Dragonwall) burned; the roof collapsed completely. He gave no attention to his burning inn while watching the newcomers.
Knows Rand. Led the Darkfriends who stole the Horn and dagger. Mentioned as having come and roused the enemy camp.

Not present in this chapter but mentioned several times. Made Lord Agelmar name Rand as Ingtar's second. One of the few strong enough to survive using the sa'angreal on Tremalking. Rand thinks Verin is 'Moiraine's eyes watching me.'
Not present. Mentioned as having given Ingtar the charge to recover the Horn. Strong enough to survive using the female sa'angreal on Tremalking. Rand remembered how to behave before her.

Not present. Mentioned hypothetically by Ingtar regarding what would have happened if he had found the sa'angreal. Verin says using it would have taken all his strength just to avoid being burned to a cinder.
Not present. Mentioned as one of the few Aes Sedai strong enough to survive using the female sa'angreal on Tremalking.
Not present. Mentioned as having named Rand as Ingtar's second at Moiraine's urging.
Not present in this scene but mentioned. With other soldiers in the Foregate. They preferred to stay outside the city walls. Will watch Barthanes's manor.
Not present. Rand thinks of her when reflecting on marriage, says 'if I could marry anyone, it would be Egwene, but she wants to be Aes Sedai.'

stable_traits.personality: Watches carefully, deferential to Aes Sedai.

characters.notes: Watched Verin heal Hurin carefully. When Verin revealed herself as Aes Sedai, the Reader made a full curtsy. A female character present at the burning inn. 'Reader' may be a title or role in Cairhien.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives at The Great Tree inn in Cairhien after his previous inn burned. Takes a room, bathes, burns Selene's letters, then joins the group in a private dining room.
appearances.notable_actions: Takes command naturally when Hurin returns with news, though apologizes to Ingtar. Burns Selene's letters in his lamp. Chooses a black coat with silver herons and rapids. Discusses the Portal Stone journey with the group. Shows determination to recover the Horn and dagger.
appearances.demeanor: Determined, increasingly confident and lordly despite his protests. Conflicted about Selene and his destiny. Growing into his role.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives in Cairhien with Ingtar's party. Goes to The Great Tree inn where she has stayed before. Takes a private dining room.
appearances.notable_actions: Heals Hurin with the One Power. Questions Rand about how he arrived in Cairhien ahead of them. Plans to use Rand's invitation to enter Barthanes's manor. Explains sa'angreal and their dangers. Crumples Galldrian's invitation. Manipulates the situation to position them to retrieve the Horn.
appearances.demeanor: Calm, thoughtful, strategic. Subtly controlling the situation. Shows concern initially, then becomes more analytical.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives with Ingtar's party at The Great Tree inn in Cairhien.
appearances.notable_actions: Juggles eggs (drops one when shocked by Rand's story). Asks repeatedly about the dagger. Eats ravenously. Questions how Rand got ahead of them.
appearances.demeanor: Feverish, flushed, increasingly ill-looking. Trying to maintain humor through juggling. Desperate about the dagger. Eating as if it's his last meal.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives with Ingtar's party at The Great Tree inn. Sits at the table, plays stones with Ingtar.
appearances.notable_actions: Helps Rand up initially. Defends Rand against Verin's questions. Plays stones with Ingtar in a new aggressive style, winning as many games as he loses. Thinks repeatedly of Rand as 'Shadowkiller.' Observes everyone's changes. Smells lamb and other scents keenly.
appearances.demeanor: Thoughtful, protective, troubled. Internally conflicted about his wolf nature and his role. Perceptive of others' transformations.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives with Ingtar's party at The Great Tree inn (claims to have walked and grown used to it).
appearances.notable_actions: Reads books from Fal Dara. Provides information about the impossibility of opening the chest without the Horn. Ears twitch nervously when crowds gather.
appearances.demeanor: Bookish, worried, somewhat nervous about the situation and crowds.

appearances.whereabouts: Arrives with his party at The Great Tree inn in Cairhien.
appearances.notable_actions: Defers somewhat to Rand's leadership initially. Plays stones with Perrin aggressively. Questions Rand about the invitations. Plans to have Uno and soldiers watch the manor. Expresses intense desire to recover the Horn ('I must have it!').
appearances.demeanor: Driven, increasingly desperate about the Horn. Respectful but skeptical of Rand's claims to be a shepherd. Impatient with waiting.

appearances.whereabouts: Initially with the group when Verin heals him. Goes out to track the trail. Returns to The Great Tree with news.
appearances.notable_actions: Is healed by Verin. Tracks the Darkfriends and Horn to Barthanes's manor. Reports Trolloc scent around the place. Mentions Rand burned all other invitations. Objects to Ingtar's intensity about 'must.'
appearances.demeanor: Initially shaky and tired from healing, then triumphant when he returns with the trail's location. Loyal and dutiful. Shows pride in 'Lord Rand.'

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; at his new manor where the Horn and dagger have been taken.
appearances.notable_actions: Sent an invitation to Rand. His manor houses the stolen Horn, with Darkfriends and Trolloc scent around it.

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; presumably in the royal palace in Cairhien.
appearances.notable_actions: Sent an invitation to Rand (which Verin discarded). Has a project to dig up and move a sa'angreal statue.
Her letters to Rand were burned by him. She previously helped them via Portal Stone.

appearances.whereabouts: At The Great Tree inn, her establishment.
appearances.notable_actions: Welcomes Verin warmly. Arranges rooms and services for the party with servants. Sharp-eyed and observant.
appearances.demeanor: Unctuous, welcoming, shrewd. Knows Verin is Aes Sedai without it being said.

appearances.whereabouts: At his burning inn, The Defender of the Dragonwall.
appearances.notable_actions: Watched the newcomers instead of his burning inn.
appearances.demeanor: Distracted from his own crisis by the arrivals.

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; has taken the Horn and dagger to Barthanes's manor.
appearances.notable_actions: Led the theft of the Horn and dagger. Knows Rand.

appearances.whereabouts: At the scene of the fire at Cuale's inn.
appearances.notable_actions: Watched Verin heal Hurin carefully. Made a full curtsy when Verin was revealed as Aes Sedai.
appearances.demeanor: Careful, observant, respectful to Aes Sedai.

relationships.description: Verin is guiding and manipulating Rand, trying to prepare him for his role. Rand is wary of her but follows her lead.
Childhood friends working together to recover the dagger that will save Mat's life.
Childhood friends. Perrin is protective and supportive of Rand, defending him to Verin. Both share secrets about their changing natures.
Ingtar named Rand his second; now somewhat defers to Rand's natural leadership despite Rand's protests. Working together to recover the Horn.
Hurin serves Rand, addressing him as 'Lord Rand' and showing pride in his status.
Traveled together through the Portal Stone. Friends and companions in the quest.
Play stones together; Ingtar gains new respect for Perrin's play style.
Both Blue Ajah; Rand thinks Verin is Moiraine's agent watching him.
Tiedra knows Verin from previous stays; shows warm welcome and knows she is Aes Sedai.
Fain knows Rand and is working against him, having stolen the Horn and dagger.
Barthanes is sheltering Fain and the stolen items at his manor, suggesting alliance with Darkfriends.
